columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Primary Key of the table. System generated.

columns.name: ENTITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of ORC entity. The corresponding lookup type is ORA_IRC_LI_RSC_ENTITY_TYPE

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Action to be excuted by the sync. The corresponding lookup type is ORA_IRC_LI_RSC_ACTION

columns.name: BATCH_COUNT
columns.description: Stores the number of records sent in the batch

columns.name: PAYLOAD
columns.description: The payload sent to LinkedIn RSC.

columns.name: RESPONSE_PAYLOAD
columns.description: The payload received from LinkedIn RSC.

columns.name: URL
columns.description: The url used when sending to LinkedIn RSC.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status of this sync action. The corresponding lookup type is ORA_IRC_LI_RSC_SYNC_STATUS

columns.name: METHOD
columns.description: Http method that used in the request.

columns.name: REQUEST_HEADERS
columns.description: Http request headers that is used here.

columns.name: RESPONSE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Http status code of http response.

columns.name: STATUS_MESSAGE
columns.description: Http status message that is returned in response.

columns.name: RESPONSE_HEADERS
columns.description: Http response headers returned from the response.

columns.name: REQUEST_START_TIME
columns.description: The time that the http request started.

columns.name: REQUEST_END_TIME
columns.description: The time that the http request ended.

columns.name: ESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Ess Job ID, the ess request ID of the job.

columns.name: PROCESSED_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date and time when the batch call was made to LinkedIn.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
